facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Sara Crewe lived in a grand school in London with her father. Her father was very rich and loved her more than anything else. One terrible day, he lost all his money and passed away in India. Sara went from being the richest girl to a poor servant overnight. Other children laughed at her torn clothes and cold attic room. But Sara held her head high and never stopped smiling at people. She believed that being a princess was about her heart, not her dress. I am still a princess.
